title: Upstream Method Ownership and Provenance Closure
root_cause: The integrated response pipeline reconstructed the owner of a DTO declaration judgment by finding a method whose response attribute source span matched the judgment request source. This made method ownership an inferred join rather than closed upstream provenance.
changes: Added a closed LaravelControllerResponseDtoDeclarationRequestOwner ADT with controller-response-attribute and DTO-property-type-reference variants.
Controller DTO declaration requests now retain the exact ControllerMethodEvidence owner that supplied the response attribute.
DTO property type-reference binding uses the distinct property owner variant.
The declaration-resolution authority preserves owner provenance when narrowing to a resolved request; unresolved and ambiguous judgments already retain the original request.
DTO response-contract projection now consumes response shape from the judgment owner and no longer re-joins controller methods by source-span equality.
Bumped the existing DTO declaration-resolution contract version from 4 to 5.
Added focused structural tests and phase documentation.
remaining_gaps: Compatibility singleton exports remain and direct consumers still require a separate call-site audit.
The full integrated response provenance closure and per-method response-product coverage still need an end-to-end audit.
Static TypeScript typecheck, Vitest, and package build have not been executed in this environment.
